context: Evaluates the implementation of the useTheme composable, which manages light/dark theming using Vue's reactivity (ref), localStorage for persistence, and the prefers-color-scheme media query for OS preference detection. The theme is applied via a data-coreui-theme attribute on the document root element, and the composable must reactively respond to OS changes only when no explicit user preference is stored.

checklist.name: Reactive theme ref
checklist.description: A Vue ref (or reactive equivalent) is used for currentTheme, and the exported currentTheme value reflects changes made via setTheme or toggleTheme.

checklist.name: localStorage read/write
checklist.description: The initial theme is read from localStorage using the correct storage key, and every call to setTheme persists the new value back to localStorage under the same key.

checklist.name: System preference detection
checklist.description: When no localStorage value exists, the composable reads window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches to determine the initial theme.

checklist.name: DOM attribute update
checklist.description: setTheme applies the theme by calling document.documentElement.setAttribute with the 'data-coreui-theme' attribute and the theme string.

checklist.name: System change listener
checklist.description: An event listener is registered on the dark-mode MediaQueryList's 'change' event, and it only applies the system theme when no value is stored in localStorage.

checklist.name: toggleTheme function
checklist.description: toggleTheme correctly toggles from 'light' to 'dark' and from 'dark' to 'light' by calling setTheme with the opposite value.
